limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 100.

offset.description: Number of matching tasks to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

query.description: Task query text. Free text matches titles and descriptions. Filters use `key:value`; repeated statuses, people, spaces, repositories, origins, pull request states, and CI states are ORed, other filters are ANDed, and `-key:value` or `key:not:value` excludes results. Quote values that contain spaces. Supported keys are created-by, commented-by, mentions, involves, space, repo, status, origin, is, pr, and ci. Use @me for the current user.
